title: A dated Diamond Sutra is printed
summary: A woodblock-printed Chinese Diamond Sutra carries a dated colophon corresponding to 868 CE. Its seven joined paper sheets record a Buddhist act of sponsorship.

citations.note: Supports the factual summary and chronology. Context includes explicitly interpretive comparisons; the date note identifies limits of precision.

claims.text: A woodblock-printed Chinese Diamond Sutra carries a dated colophon corresponding to 868 CE. Its seven joined paper sheets record a Buddhist act of sponsorship.
The source converts the colophon to 11 May 868; this preview uses year precision because calendar-conversion details need further review.
A dated surviving object provides unusually direct evidence for book history. The oldest surviving dated example should not be equated with the invention of woodblock printing.
